qaNote: Reference inspected: adult woman, white robe/towel and dark teal swimsuit/slides. Preserve costume colors; teal garment and sandals are a major cyan-key masking risk and must be tested before acceptance. Review foam boundaries, towel continuity, cleanse payoff, title and anatomy.
choreography:
IDENTITY: the exact adult athletic brown-skinned woman from the reference, large curly brown high bun with loose curls at her face, gold hoop earrings, dark teal one-piece athletic swimsuit with white fist emblem, open white bathrobe, long white towel held between her hands, teal-and-white slide sandals. Preserve her costume, confident face and hairstyle. Athletic action framing centered on her face, arms and prop. Do not add a pool, hot tub, room or floor.
0–0.7s: establish full body as she draws the long white towel taut. Far behind her floats a small golden FIST emblem trapped inside a jagged black charcoal shell, a graphic symbol of a disabled ally rather than another person.
0.7–2.5s: she whips the towel upward, then snaps it forward with both hands. Camera pulls backward hard: the towel's motion raises a towering curling wave of dense white bath foam with warm ivory highlights, pale rose shadows and bold black ink contours, many times taller than she is. The wave sweeps over the trapped emblem in ONE powerful crest; the charcoal shell dissolves into harmless round black soap bubbles that pop, revealing the bright gold fist intact. A thunderous towel CRACK and a rolling water-and-foam BOOM on the cleanse. This is an isolated sculptural effect on pure cyan, not an ocean, translucent blue water, fog or a background fill. Keep clear cyan margins around the crest.
2.5–3.5s: snap close to her face as she retracts the same towel, collapsing the immense foam wave into one small clean white puff. Exact title SOAK YOUR PROBLEMS slams in two lines below her face. The restored gold fist briefly shines beside her shoulder, then rises away.
3.5–5s: full-body confident hold with the towel draped over one shoulder. A tiny yellow rubber duck drops from the towel into her open palm; she gives it an unimpressed glance, and it produces one tiny squeak. Stable costume and title, clean hand anatomy. SFX: cloth stretch, gigantic towel snap, cresting foam roar, three bubble pops, title impact, single rubber-duck squeak. No speech, music or sensual motion.

qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve messy brown hair, dark oversized hoodie, charcoal cargo trousers, battered sneakers and silver device with simple colored geometric stickers. Review isolated megaphones, laptop hinge continuity, readable title and final face visibility.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact adult light-skinned man with messy shaggy brown hair, tired narrow eyes, short stubble, oversized dark charcoal-blue hoodie, gray undershirt, charcoal cargo trousers and scuffed gray/off-white lace-up sneakers. Preserve the small silver laptop tucked against his chest, with the same simple colored circle/triangle/diamond stickers. Maintain annoyed comic expression, not a glamorous makeover.
0–0.7s: establish his complete crouched figure, clutching the laptop. Three enormous floating silver megaphones crowd him from different angles; they emit only short abstract warm-white zigzag sound strokes, no speech, writing or faces. He shoots them an irritated sideways glance.
0.7–2.5s: he opens the laptop only a few inches and SLAMS its lid shut with both palms. From that one emphatic snap, a gigantic thick ivory shock ring with black ink edges expands outward. Camera rockets backward to show the small man at its center while all three oversized megaphones flip inside out like rubber funnels and rocket away to tiny specks at different depths. Hold the dominant lid-contact beat for a moment, then explosive acceleration. The expanding ring and speed strokes are finite shapes on cyan; never a solid full-screen flash, rectangular backdrop or new environment.
2.5–3.5s: camera punches back into his annoyed face, laptop hugged to his chest. Exact title LEAVE ME ALONE drops into place with a heavy angled slam below the face. He pulls one hoodie drawstring and gives a stubborn one-shoulder shrug.
3.5–5s: return to complete-character pose with his face still readable inside the hood. One miniature defeated megaphone drifts back toward his sneaker; he nudges it away with one lazy toe flick without looking. Stable final title and silhouette. SFX: overlapping abrasive horn squeaks without voices, laptop CLAP, gigantic expanding bass THOOM, three rubbery receding whistles, sudden clean quiet, title slam and a tiny final squeak. No music or intelligible voices.
